convergence_decisions.decision: The one-shot trial Run is converged onto the group-domain transport on both tiers: the trial Group is created through the reviewed persistent-form product-CLI create leaf (planner/reviewer bindings stored on the Group, group_strategy=state_machine pinned by the server), and the single Run is started by the raw group-domain HTTP exit POST /groups/{group_id}/state-machine-runs beside the frozen product CLI. The frozen bcs-cli exposes no group-domain run verb and is never modified; the native verb is a product gap tracked by DIMA with this surgery. Run-domain CLI reads, the respond guard refusal, the Run cancel, the session read, and the exact owned Group delete with 404 proof follow unchanged. The session-domain membership, permission and session-domain run-start leaves of the frozen owned-local parent are not re-chained on either tier; the difference is pinned in the trial projection and disclosed in the case report. Superseded 2026-10-31 by 20261030-s14-session-domain-run-start-restored: the reviewed one-shot Run transport is the session-domain product-CLI 'collaborate run' leaf on both tiers; the raw group-domain HTTP exit stays a declared fallback route binding and is never executed.

live_evidence.disclosed_condition: Real preprod Bot runtimes did not consume the bot_task node inside the live 75s window (plan node awaiting_response until cancel); consumption is disclosed as a live condition and is never asserted.
results: POST /groups/{group_id}/state-machine-runs returned 202 running with run_id, a group-derived session_id (prefix group_id + ':'), bound group_id, and created_by=human_<user_id>
CLI graph projection reads the derived Run and its nodes
--pending returned [] (Bot-only Run exposes no pending Human inputs)
collaborate respond guard refused by policy (nonzero exit contract)
POST /state-machine-runs/{run_id}/cancel returned 200 and the Run reached a terminal aborted state
DELETE /groups/{group_id}?bot_id={driver} returned 200; the Group, the derived Session and the Run all verified absent (404) afterwards

convergence_decisions.decision: The session-domain membership and permission leaves are re-chained on both tiers through the frozen product bcs-cli (upstream cli-stories.sh:180-196 anchors: session add-member --role consultant as the driver, collaborate permission --session). Wave-2 had excluded them while every preprod leg was BLOCKED; the density increment requires their real assertions on both tiers. The human participant is the case-owned Human fixture; effect admission for the dedicated fixture-pool Bots was granted by the operator for this change.

The one-shot Run start is restored to the upstream session-domain product CLI leaf (cli-stories.sh:206-209: collaborate run <yaml> --session <id> --binding planner=<driver> --binding reviewer=<member> --input <trial input>) as the primary dual transport, symmetric with the owned-local parent. The group-domain raw HTTP exit stays declared in route_bindings as the documented fallback for tiers where the frozen CLI session verb is unavailable; the r13 derived-session dual projections are retired with this decision.

requirements.expectation: Product CLI creates the exact two-role custom collaboration Group with its initial Session handle; CLI readback reports driver, participants, and group_strategy=state_machine before cleanup.

source.text:
_cli_story_run "operator creates the custom collaboration group" PM \
        collaboration create "$yaml_file" --driver "$BOT_PM_UUID" \
        --binding "planner=$BOT_PM_UUID" --binding "reviewer=$BOT_ENG_UUID" \
        --context "Review release readiness through a custom workflow" \
        --topic "CLI custom release workflow" || {
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }
    group_id=$(json_path "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "id")
    assert_not_empty "custom collaboration group returns an id" "$group_id"
    assert_contains "custom collaboration group contains its driver" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "$BOT_PM_UUID"
    assert_contains "custom collaboration group contains its reviewer" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "$BOT_ENG_UUID"
    rm -f "$yaml_file"
    [[ -n "$group_id" ]] || return

    api_get "/groups/${group_id}"
    require_status "operator reads the custom collaboration group" "200" || return
    assert_json_eq "custom collaboration group uses state-machine strategy" "$RESPONSE" "group_strategy" "state_machine"

    api_delete "/groups/${group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
    require_status "custom collaboration fixture is cleaned up" "200" || return

requirements.command: bcs-cli create-group + session add-member + collaborate permission + collaborate run + collaborate query --graph/--pending + collaborate respond guard + session messages + run cancel/session read/group delete
requirements.expectation: Product CLI creates the owned temporary chat Group, joins the exact Human session member, confirms current-session state-machine permission, starts the one-shot Run with fixed bindings/input, reads the exact graph, pending Human, guarded respond refusal, restored state-machine history, then cancels the Run and deletes the temporary Group while the Session remains running.

source.text:
_cli_story_create_pm_group "CLI one-shot custom collaboration trial" || {
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }
    trial_group_id="$CLI_STORY_GROUP_ID"
    trial_session_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" | sed -n 's/^  Session: //p' | head -1)
    assert_not_empty "one-shot trial group returns its current session" "$trial_session_id"
    if [[ -z "$trial_session_id" ]]; then
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    fi

    # Pending-input reads authorize the Human, independently of the Bot token
    # used to start a one-shot Run. Join the operator to the trial session.
    _cli_story_run "operator joins the trial session as a Human" PM \
        session add-member "$trial_session_id" \
        --bot-uuid "human_${BCS_MOCK_USER_ID}" --role consultant || {
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }

    _cli_story_run "operator checks current-session state-machine permission" PM \
        collaborate permission --session "$trial_session_id" || {
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }
    assert_json_eq "group owner may run a one-shot state machine" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "allowed" "true"
    assert_json_eq "permission belongs to the current session" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "session_id" "$trial_session_id"
    assert_json_eq "permission belongs to the temporary chat group" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "group_id" "$trial_group_id"

    _cli_story_run "operator trials the custom collaboration in the current session" PM \
        collaborate run "$yaml_file" --session "$trial_session_id" \
        --binding "planner=$BOT_PM_UUID" --binding "reviewer=$BOT_ENG_UUID" \
        --input '{"question":"Review the release workflow before persisting it."}' || {
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }
    run_id=$(json_path "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "run.run_id")
    assert_not_empty "one-shot custom collaboration returns a run id" "$run_id"
    assert_json_eq "one-shot run stays in the current session" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "run.session_id" "$trial_session_id"
    assert_json_eq "one-shot run stays in the temporary chat group" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "run.group_id" "$trial_group_id"
    if [[ -z "$run_id" ]]; then
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    fi

    _cli_story_run "operator queries the exact one-shot execution graph" PM \
        collaborate query --run "$run_id" --graph || return
    assert_json_eq "CLI graph keeps the Run identity" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "run.run_id" "$run_id"
    _cli_story_run "operator checks pending Human input through CLI" PM \
        collaborate query --run "$run_id" --pending || return
    assert_eq "Bot-only workflow exposes no Human response target" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "[]"
    # Exercise the reply guard against a real Bot-only Run; it must never POST
    # a Human response to a node absent from the authorized pending list.
    if bcs_cli_json PM collaborate respond --run "$run_id" --node plan --content "invalid Human reply"; then
        assert_eq "CLI refuses a non-pending Human node" "accepted" "rejected"
    else
        assert_contains "CLI explains that the node is not pending" "$BCS_CLI_STDERR" "not pending"
    fi

    _cli_story_run "operator reloads current-session history after the one-shot run" PM \
        session messages "$trial_session_id" --view-bot "$BOT_PM_UUID" --limit 50 || {
        bot_post "/state-machine-runs/${run_id}/cancel" PM '{"reason":"E2E cleanup"}'
        api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
        rm -f "$yaml_file"
        return
    }
    assert_contains "one-shot history restores the AixUI state-machine panel" \
        "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "bcsPanel.StateMachineRunView"
    assert_contains "restored AixUI panel points at the one-shot run" "$BCS_CLI_STDOUT" "$run_id"

    bot_post "/state-machine-runs/${run_id}/cancel" PM \
        '{"reason":"E2E one-shot trial completed"}'
    require_status "operator cancels the one-shot trial" "200" || return
    cleanup_status=$(json_path "$RESPONSE" "run.status")
    case "$cleanup_status" in
        aborted|completed|failed) cleanup_status="terminal" ;;
    esac
    assert_eq "one-shot trial is terminal after cleanup" "$cleanup_status" "terminal"

    api_get "/sessions/${trial_session_id}"
    require_status "operator reads the chat session after the one-shot trial" "200" || return
    assert_json_eq "one-shot execution preserves the chat session" "$RESPONSE" "status" "running"

    api_delete "/groups/${trial_group_id}?bot_id=${BOT_PM_UUID}"
    require_status "one-shot custom collaboration fixture is cleaned up" "200" || return
